result: Across the five frozen curves, none of the 25 parity-orbit polynomials has a nontrivial polynomial composition; every coefficient sequence has maximal finite-window linear complexity; and successor, doubling, negation, and GLV state relations appear only at ordinary interpolation thresholds, with negation exactly explained by the swap involution.
claim_boundary: No production secp256k1 relation lower bound, unrestricted arithmetic-circuit lower bound, parity oracle, or sub-square-root ECDLP algorithm is claimed.
